text: The consolidated folder getMsgInputStream takes a message header and preserves IMAP Gmail lookup for a body stored in another folder. That override finds the other header and dispatches to its folder; its same-folder branch explicitly calls nsMsgDBFolder::GetMsgInputStream. Calling the store directly would bypass that folder lookup and uses a different folder/token/size contract. Preserve the receiver and explicit base dispatch when editing these message readers. The returned folder stream is documented as one message and not necessarily seekable. Static source only.
title: Keep the folder-specific offline lookup when consolidating message stream methods
